title: Author an original hero cab and icon identity
Frame hygiene: per-entity and core per-frame allocations (headlights, vehicleSize, shake/weather scratch)
Frame hygiene: marker and cone renderers allocate Paints and rebuild glyph Paths every frame
Frame hygiene: the weather overlay opens up to two full-viewport saveLayers per frame
Frame hygiene: the per-frame headway pass materialises the traffic list, is O(n^2), and the player rescans all children
Frame hygiene: the endless fare controller rebuilds a full fare every frame for the horizon test
Frame hygiene: TrafficSpawner rebuilds the whole traffic profile every frame to read one scalar
Frame hygiene: background builds a gradient Shader and Paints every frame
Frame hygiene: road chunk render re-samples geometry and rebuilds Paths/Paints every frame
The stats screen's empty gate reads the window, hiding lifetime totals after a history-only loss
A daily started across midnight pins the next day's key to the previous day's course
Personal-best maxima are never seeded from the run-history window, so they can regress
A save issued mid-reset encodes the old save and resurrects wiped progress on the next launch
Midnight rollover: the menu's daily card can name yesterday while its button starts today
An abandoned RESET reports nothing: the player is told the wipe happened when it did not
NEXT LEVEL is not latched: a doubled tap races two loads and can skip a rung
Bare pop() exits are not re-entry safe: a doubled same-frame tap pops the menu route too
NEXT LEVEL tears the completion panel down before a throwing load, and no UI surface catches the throw
Settings' About tiles push unguarded: two taps stack the same screen (#220's fix missed them)
No AVAudioSession interruption or route-change handling: engine and music state go stale on a device
CloseCallFeedback.play fires SystemSound.play unawaited and uncaught
iOS audio-session setup failure is swallowed and leaves the plugin's .playback default standing
'Diagnostics cleared.' shows even when the erase failed
resetProgress clears and saves without awaiting, so a partial flush leaves a fresh save beside old records
Unguarded startup awaits before runApp softlock the launch screen on a storage or orientation failure
Saves are fire-and-forget: write failures are invisible and cross-key state can diverge after a kill
A level that fails to parse silently becomes the Test Level and still unlocks the next level
'initialize is safe to call twice' asserts nothing
Three launch-lifecycle probes assert only survival, so a no-op lifecycleStateChange stays green
Kerb-reach test re-declares the 40 px detection radius, so shrinking PickupZone.detectionRadius goes unseen
blankFileRefused scans to EOF and set_review_notes satisfies it, masking a downgraded blank-file refusal
Release-gate test passes after the What's New guard's exit 1 is deleted (tokens satisfied by the 4.3(a) guard)
